content: तर A Taddhita affix of the comparative degree, added to adjectives, nouns, and also to verbs and indeclinables in which latter case it is changed to तराम्. It is added, like तम, to pronouns in the sense of ‘one of two’ {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} कतर, ततर, यतर <ab>&c.</ab>
तर, तरण, तरणि, तरण्ड, तरि-री, तरीष <ab>&c.</ab>¦ See under तॄ.

तर {%a.%} [तॄ-भावे-अप्] .²1 Crossing. .²2 Surpassing, excelling. .²3 Conquering, overpowering; <ab>cf.</ab> दुस्तर. .{@-रः@} .²1 Passing over, crossing, passage; उत्तेऊरतरान् नदान् <ls>Bk. 7. 55</ls>. .²2 Freight; दीर्घाध्वनि यथादेशं यथाकालं तरो भवेत् <ls>Ms. 8. 406</ls>. .²3 A road. .²4 A ferry-boat. .²5 Fire.
